messages:
Alex W: Hi all :wave: I'm on my first day and can't open any of the observability dashboards (Datadog/Grafana/Sentry). Okta shows the apps but they 403 when I try to open. Who should I ping for access?

devex-bot: Hi Alex — welcome! Please try the self-service access flow first: https://okta.redwood.com/app/home. If that doesn't work, ping @eng-observability or post here with your Okta username. :rocket:

Maria C: Hey Alex — usually a group membership issue. Can you share your Okta username and whether you're on the company VPN? Datadog and Grafana require SSO group access, Sentry is SSO+org role.

Alex W: Username is alex.w@redwood.com. I'm on my home network right now, not on VPN. I can hop on the VPN, do we need it for Grafana?

Ben R: For Grafana + internal dashboards yes, please connect to the 'redwood-vpn' for first-time access. Quick command:
```
openvpn --config ~/redwood/redwood-vpn.ovpn
```
If you don't have the .ovpn file, grab it from the Remote Access page in the console or DM infra-ops.

Jordana L: I can add you to the groups — I'll add alex.w@redwood.com to `grafana-viewers`, `datadog-read`, and the Sentry org viewer. Give it ~5-10 mins after I add.

Jordana L: Done — added to grafana-viewers and datadog-read, invited to Sentry org. Should be effective now. :white_check_mark:

devex-bot: Access change logged: grant by Jordana L to alex.w@redwood.com for groups [grafana-viewers, datadog-read, sentry-viewer].

Alex W: Confirmed — I can now load Grafana and Datadog dashboards. Sentry link works too. Thanks everyone! :tada:

Maria C: Great — if any dashboards are missing, post the names and we'll check perms or datasource access. Also FYI we run weekly observability office hours in #eng-observability every Tue 11am PT.

Alex W: Got it, I'll join. Appreciate the quick help.
